title: meta
description: What the board says about itself, from describe meta: the tool's version and running build, which decides the preview banner, and the git checkout the design sits in, with when the design last changed. A reader asks it again when the revision's meta or board part moves.

apiVersion.description: Always elderlygate/designer/app/v1: the form of e-designer's answers. An app's answers keep the family app (apiversion/v1/forms.yaml), apart from the files they describe.

kind.description: Always Meta, the kind of this answer, so a reader knows which schema its data meets.

ran.description: Where the answer came from; this contract fixes the app and the contract version, so an answer from anything else fails here.

app.description: Always designer, e-designer's product ID, since only e-designer gives this answer.

contract.description: Always v1, the contract version this schema belongs to.

data.description: What the board says about itself: the running build, with the tool's version, and the checkout the design sits in, with when the design last changed. A fact that cannot be known is left out, never guessed.

since.description: How far the tool's own tree is past its nearest tag, and which tag, against running.version; absent when git cannot say, as in a container.

ahead.description: How many commits past it; 0 on the tag itself.

running.description: What the running build was made from, and whether it is a release from main. source says where that comes from: the NW_BUILD_BRANCH, NW_BUILD_COMMIT, NW_BUILD_DIRTY and NW_BUILD_TAG stamp, as a container has no .git, else the tool's own checkout. Kept apart from branch and commit, which describe the checkout the design's writes land in.

source.description: Where the build's facts come from, an open word a reader decides by (G-STACK-15). Known words: stamp: what stamped the image it runs from, shown for a board with no checkout of its own; checkout: the tool's own checkout.

version.description: The tool's version, its release tag without the v (6.29.0); absent for a dev build, unless the tool's checkout is exactly on a release tag, which it then names. released is decided against it. The envelope's ran.version carries the tag itself (v6.29.0).

branch.description: The branch it was built from; absent on a detached HEAD or when nothing says.

commit.description: The short commit it was built from, in lowercase hex; absent when nothing says.

dirty.description: The tree it was built from held changes its commit does not; absent when nothing says.

tag.description: The release tag on the built commit, v<version>, when it carries one.

released.description: Whether this is a release from main: the built commit carries the tag v<version>, from a clean tree, on main or a detached HEAD. Decided by the server, so every page agrees; a page that is not a release wears the preview banner.

commit.description: The short commit of the checkout the design sits in, in lowercase hex; absent outside a checkout.

branch.description: The branch the design's writes land on, from git; absent on a detached HEAD with nothing to name.

dirty.description: The design's checkout holds changes its commit does not; absent outside a checkout or when git cannot say.

boardBranch.description: The branch board sessions are meant to run on, from NW_BOARD_BRANCH; a branch that differs is shown, never refused.

offBoard.description: True when the design's writes land on another branch than board sessions are meant to run on: branch and boardBranch are both known and differ, so a position nudged here lands in a commit about something else. Decided by e-designer, the rule its start warning uses too, so every reader agrees; the difference is shown, never refused. Always given.

updatedAt.description: When a file of the design last changed, in milliseconds since the epoch; absent when the design holds no file.

updatedWhat.description: Which file that was, as a path inside the design, never a machine path.
